objective: Proof: in RING-PAIR's scope, round t's junctions are in bijection with the deck orbits of clusters of size t + 1 containing a knot, parents corresponding to removable points and loose bits to boundary points; the union lemma from the candidate complex's incidence girth; and the first step that needs a hypothesis outside it.
status: Proved 2026-11-19 (refereed R1, confirmed): under RING-PAIR's scope plus a cycle in the knot graph, round t's junctions are the deck orbits of clusters of t + 1 points of the unrolled candidate map, parents the removable points and loose distinctions the boundary points, every round; the union lemma from the candidate complex's incidence girth (at least 8); the cycle condition cannot be dropped (two stars joined at their centres); the wider class's first failing steps located (relays, the floor, round-1 groups of three).
title: The identification theorem on RING-PAIR's scope
